answer: Charge registration per funding source, not per identity: the first identity from one wallet pays 25 POA, the second 50, the third 100, doubling each time, locked six epochs. Honest newcomers enter through the harbor at the base fee. Ten fakes from one pot cost 25,575 POA in total, and the curve climbs toward a summit no single operator can afford. Fresh wallets do not help: the chain links identities by withdrawal graph and shared payout addresses, merging their fee ladders. Each payment leaves a relic entry in the public fee ledger, so anyone can audit the ladder and verify each lock.
